description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Darksteel Angel
When Darksteel Angel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
